shared_elements: horizontal register bands dividing the surface
row of arch- or loop-shaped motifs along the top edge
band of repeated zigzag / triangle chevron ornament
quadruped animals in profile low relief
weathered pale limestone slab with rounded upper edge, shown in situ in an excavation
justification: Both slabs use the identical tripartite scheme: a top row of arch/handle-shaped motifs, a horizontal band of zigzag-triangle ornament immediately below, and beneath it profile animals accompanied by a disc, all in the same shallow, flat-relief, hard-edged carving on pale weathered stone. The main differences are that B is a taller pillar continuing into a second lower field with a large bird and vertical elements, and its figures are somewhat crisper and more legible than A's shallower, more eroded and compressed panel.
